card.name: Start of the word regimen
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word 'regimen' (Reg- or reg-) when it is split before '-imen', mostly after 'Dosage', 'Dose' or 'maintenance' in dosing headings. Also seen after 'month' in '6-month' before 'treatment regimen'.

modes.label: Dosage Regimen headings
modes.description: 'Reg' split off after 'Dosage' or 'Recommended Dosage' in a section title.
modes.example: 2.1 Recommended Dosage<< Reg>>imen The recommended dose of Kepiv

modes.label: Named regimen types
modes.description: 'Reg' after a dose level or duration, naming a specific treatment plan.
modes.example: Restart Low Dose<< Reg>>imen with 12 mg loading doses

modes.label: Duration before regimen
modes.description: The hyphenated month after a number, where 'regimen' is expected next.
modes.example: initial 2 months of a 6<<-month>> or longer treatment regimen for drug-sus

card.writes: It pushes the model to complete the word as regimen or regime, or a similar word such as course.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a dosing plan is about to be called a regimen.
